name: expression_parser
description: A tokenizer, recursive-descent parser and evaluator for arithmetic expressions with variables, functions and chained assignments.
bugs: expr() recurses on the right-hand side instead of looping, making + and - right-associative
power() loops over ^ with atom() operands, making ^ left-associative and rejecting signed exponents
unary minus is handled inside atom() instead of unary(), so it binds tighter than ^ (-2^2 == 4)
